rules:
**Gorbachof Modding Hub — Rules**

1. Treat other members with basic respect. Harassment, targeted abuse, hate speech, slurs, threats, or sustained personal attacks are not permitted.
2. Use the text channel for the mod you are discussing. Keep support/report chats usable; for a distinct bug or troubleshooting case, start a thread when practical and include the game version, mod version, reproduction details, and relevant saves/logs/screenshots.
3. Do not spam, flood, mass-mention, or repeatedly ping maintainers for updates.
4. Do not post malware, credential-stealing links, scams, or deliberately unsafe downloads.
5. Do not post sexually explicit content or graphic gore.
6. Do not redistribute proprietary game files, leaked material, or copyrighted mod assets you do not have permission to redistribute.
7. Criticism is allowed. Keep it about the mod, compatibility, balance, implementation, or maintenance decision rather than attacking people.
8. Respect original authors. Revivals, maintenance forks, and compatches should preserve clear credit and links to the original work where available.
9. Follow Discord's Terms of Service and Community Guidelines.
10. Repeated or serious violations can result in timeout, kick, or ban.
11. Content submitted in support, request, and testing channels—including saves, logs, screenshots, Workshop links, and other attachments—may be retrieved and reviewed by development automation for troubleshooting, triage, maintenance, fixing, compatibility work, and balancing.
server-guide:
**Welcome to the Gorbachof Modding Hub**

This server covers the full creator catalog: revived/updated mods, compatibility patches, maintenance work, utilities, and original projects.

**Support & Reports is organized first by game, then by mod.**

**VICTORIA 3 — SUPPORT & REPORTS**
- **#stockpile-economy** — Stockpile Economy Continued
- **#stockpile-tech-res** — Stockpile Economy Continued - Tech & Res
- **#private-sector-construction** — Private Sector Construction Continued
- **#private-sector-construction-tech-res** — Private Sector Construction Continued - Tech & Res
- **#bpm-vfm-compatch** — Better Politics Mod - Victorian Flavor Mod Compatch
- **#psc-stockpile-replacement** — PSC + Stockpile Replacement Pack
- **#psc-stockpile-replacement-tech-res** — PSC + Stockpile Replacement Pack (Tech & Res Compatible)
- **#law-enforcement-overhaul** — Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul
- **#law-enforcement-overhaul-tech-res** — Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul - Tech & Res
- **#shattered-world** — Shattered World - Every State a Country (1.15 Updated)
- **#tech-res-3d-extension** — Tech & Res - 3D Model Extension (WIP)

**Other game support**

**HEARTS OF IRON IV — SUPPORT & REPORTS**
- **#rkplus-road-to-56-compatch** — Reichskommissariats Plus x Road to 56 Compatch

**WORKERS & RESOURCES — SUPPORT & REPORTS**
- **#smart-workforce** — Smart Workforce - Auto-Close Full Factories
- **#foreign-workers-auto-refill** — Foreign Workers Auto Refill (140)

Ask installation questions, report bugs, describe compatibility problems, or give balance/behavior feedback in that mod's channel. For a distinct problem, start a thread when practical.

**Want an abandoned mod revived?** Use **#revival-requests** and include the Workshop link.
**Want a compatch?** Use **#compatch-requests** with links to both parent mods.
**Want releases?** Follow **#releases**.

Support/report/request posts and attachments may be retrieved by project automation for maintenance and troubleshooting.

faq:
**FAQ**

**Where do I get help or report a bug?** Go to the **SUPPORT & REPORTS** category for your game, then use the dedicated text channel for the mod. Start a thread for a distinct issue when practical.

**Victoria 3:** use the channel matching the exact mod or edition you installed, including **#law-enforcement-overhaul** for Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul and the dedicated replacement-pack channels for the combined PSC + Stockpile editions.

**Hearts of Iron IV:** **#rkplus-road-to-56-compatch**

**Workers & Resources:** **#smart-workforce** or **#foreign-workers-auto-refill**

**Which PSC + Stockpile pack do I use?**
- Without Tech & Res: **PSC + Stockpile Replacement Pack**
- With Tech & Res 1.7: **Private Sector Construction + Stockpile Economy - Replacement Pack (Tech & Res Compatible)**
Do not enable either combined pack alongside the separate PSC or Stockpile editions. Do not enable both combined packs at once.

**Can I attach saves and logs?** Yes. They may be reviewed by development automation as part of troubleshooting.

**Which Law Enforcement edition do I use?**
- Without Tech & Res: **Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul**
- With Tech & Res 1.7: **Law Enforcement Institution Overhaul - Tech & Res**
Do not enable both editions at the same time.

**Shattered World reports:** use **#shattered-world** and include the affected state/country or AI behavior when relevant.

**Tech & Res 3D extension:** load Tech & Res first, then the 3D extension. It is a work-in-progress visual mod; report model assignment, scale or animation issues in **#tech-res-3d-extension** with screenshots when useful.
